node.title: Half-distance A=3 slope-slack rational-normal ledger
node.statement: At the half-distance budget B=2^39+1, every live A=3 moving-kernel branch with m=2^37 and m+1<=e<=floor((4m-1)/3) has a primitive apolar generator whose e+1 parameter coefficients are independent. The transposed Hankel pencil gives a degree-e rational normal kernel curve of exact separation rank e+1. If T violates the target T<=4m+1 and h=4e+1-T, then 0<=h<=4(e-m)-1. The root-incidence matrix has exact rank and product-code weight, capacity deficit at most e+h(4m-1), at least max(0,16m-e-h(4m-1)) saturated rows, and at least T-(4m-1-3e) completely split generic columns. On h=0, the norm residual has degree at most e, complementary factors exist over at least 16m-e rows, and component bidegrees lie in unique necessary chambers. At e=m+1 only h=0,1,2,3 remain, all with at least 3m+2 saturated rows. The A=1 profile is not covered.
